name: wherever-app-spike
description: THROWAWAY Capacitor shell. Built only to observe whether an app-owned WebView keeps the WebSocket alive across an Android app switch. See work/tasks/backlog/capacitor-webview-socket-spike.md. Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace: adding it to pnpm-workspace.yaml would change pnpm-lock.yaml and stale the pnpmDepsHash pinned in package.nix, and it has no JS dependency on the workspace (it consumes the BUILT ../web/build directory, not a package).
